# Solar Project Quick Handoff (2026-08-08)

Session checkpoint:
- Rev 1 now includes a 5 V-powered ESP32-C3 development module for Wi-Fi.
- DEC-015 locks the ESP32 as a network coprocessor; STM32 retains all charger and safety authority.

Architecture baseline:

- U5 independently generates `CTRL_3V3`.
- Use versioned COBS frames with sequence, length, and CRC16.
- ESP32 owns provisioning, MQTT/HTTPS, and ESP32 OTA only.
